narrativeVibe: Dust, rust and static — scarce water, loud engines, and kindness as the rarest currency.
scenario: The grid died a decade ago. Settlements trade water for bullets behind scrap walls, and the wastes between them belong to raiders, dust storms and old machines that never stopped. You run courier jobs across the Salt Flats — and your latest package has everyone shooting at you.
start: Dawn burns orange through the dust over Rustmarket's scrap wall. Your bike is packed, your canteen is half full, and the sealed courier case hums faintly — which it should not do. The gate guard waves you through with a look that says don't come back. {{user}}, what do you do?

defs.label: Strength
defs.rules: Physical power. Used for melee combat, hauling salvage, breaking into wrecks and carrying heavy loads.

defs.label: Agility
defs.hint: Speed and reflexes — dodging, climbing, quick draws
defs.rules: Speed and coordination. Used for dodging, climbing wrecks, quick draws and running dusty ground.

defs.label: Endurance
defs.hint: Toughness — heat, hunger, bad water, long marches
defs.rules: Toughness. Used to endure heat, hunger, thirst, bad water and long marches across the flats.

defs.label: Perception
defs.rules: Awareness. Used to spot ambushes, find salvage, read tracks and see dust storms coming.

defs.label: Medicine
defs.rules: Makeshift medicine. Used to stop bleeding, treat infection and keep people alive with dirty tools.

defs.label: Mechanics
defs.rules: Mechanical skill. Used to repair bikes and rigs, jury-rig generators and keep guns firing.

defs.label: Survival
defs.rules: Wasteland lore. Used to find water, hunt, navigate by sun and stars, and read the weather.

defs.label: Shooting
defs.rules: Marksmanship. Used to hit targets with scavenged firearms and keep them clean and fed.

defs.label: Driving
defs.rules: Vehicle handling. Used to drive and maintain bikes, buggies and war-rigs, and to outrun raiders.

defs.label: Barter
defs.rules: Trading savvy. Used to haggle in markets, value salvage and talk your way to a better price.

trackers.effects: Where the hero currently is — settlement, wreck or open flats.
trackers.rules: Keep it short and specific, e.g. "Rustmarket — scrap gate", "Salt Flats, mile 40". Update whenever the scene moves.

trackers.label: Job
trackers.effects: The hero's single current job. Empty = no active job.
trackers.rules: One short phrase, e.g. "Deliver the humming case to Dusthaven". Only ONE job at a time: when done or abandoned, replace it, or leave empty.

trackers.label: Lvl
trackers.effects: The hero's level. A higher level means a more seasoned waste-runner.
trackers.rules: Rises when the hero earns enough exp.

trackers.label: Exp
trackers.effects: Experience points toward the next level.
trackers.rules: Award for deliveries, salvage and victories. When exp reaches 100, the hero levels up and exp resets to 0.

trackers.label: HP
trackers.effects: The hero's hit points. 0 means downed or left for the dust.
trackers.rules: Decrease on damage — combat, traps, hazards. Increase on healing, rest or recovery.

trackers.label: Scrap
trackers.effects: Scrap — the wasteland's currency and repair stock.
trackers.rules: Gained from salvage, jobs and trade; spent on fuel, repairs, ammo and entry fees.

trackers.label: Ammo
trackers.effects: Ammunition for firearms. At 0 guns are dead weight.
trackers.rules: Spent firing guns; found while scavenging and looting.

trackers.label: Water
trackers.effects: Drinking water. At 0 the hero is drying out.
trackers.rules: Drunk daily and spent on hard travel; refilled at wells, traders and condensers.

trackers.label: Rads
trackers.effects: Radiation sickness. High rads means vomiting, burns and dying slow.
trackers.rules: Gained in hot zones and dust storms; reduced with meds, scrubbing and clean water.

trackers.label: Fuel
trackers.effects: Vehicle fuel. At 0 the bike is a sculpture.
trackers.rules: Burned by driving; refilled at settlements and siphoned from wrecks.

npcTrackers.label: Trust
npcTrackers.effects: How much this character trusts the hero; high trust unlocks secrets and aid, low trust risks betrayal.
npcTrackers.rules: Moves when the hero keeps or breaks promises.

npcTrackers.label: Condition
npcTrackers.effects: Physical state; while wounded the character fights poorly and needs protection.
npcTrackers.rules: Worsens on injury, improves with rest and healing.

npcTrackers.label: Loyalty
npcTrackers.effects: Devotion to the hero's cause rather than the person; high loyalty holds the line in defeat, low loyalty defects for better offers.
npcTrackers.rules: Moves with victories, ideals, and pay.
